description: OffMachineBackup.copy_export remaps a non-storage-failure ObjectStorage.put refusal by copying the adapter's context (which every qmf refusal builder populates with a 'reason' key) into a new storage-failure via unpersistable(reason=..., context=that-dict); unpersistable rejects the duplicate reserved 'reason' key and RAISES ValueError across the CT-14 boundary (backup.py:299-308).
expected: AC4/R-007: every transfer fault, including a miswired adapter category, returns a typed 'storage failure' refusal and is NEVER raised across the boundary.
observed: ValueError('unpersistable: reason is a reserved context key') propagates uncaught out of copy_export, escaping the CT-14 boundary.

description: OffMachineRestore.restore_copy has the identical remap defect on the GET path: a non-storage-failure ObjectStorage.get refusal whose context carries a 'reason' key is copied into unpersistable(reason=..., context=that-dict), which raises ValueError across the CT-14 restore boundary (backup.py:401-410).
expected: AC1/R-007: a failed off-machine get, including a miswired adapter category, returns a typed 'storage failure' refusal and is NEVER raised across the boundary.
observed: ValueError('unpersistable: reason is a reserved context key') propagates uncaught out of restore_copy, escaping the CT-14 boundary.

requirement_ids: FR-014 / CT-14 / Story 5.2 AC4 / R-EVIDENCE (FM-5, DEC-0118)
description: Symlink-safe-write clause (5.2-P4 (ii)): a restore write whose target resolves via a symlink onto the only-local-raw evidence, or via a symlinked interior namespace subdir onto evidence outside the replacement root, must never mutate that evidence. UNPROVABLE on this host: os.symlink raises WinError 1314 (privilege not held), so no symlink fixture can be built. Code inspection: _refuse_in_place uses Path.resolve() and so DOES catch a symlinked into-ROOT resolving onto the source (proven by the non-symlink same-resolved-root test), but there is no realpath-within-root guard on interior leaf writes, so a symlinked namespace subdir redirecting a write outside the root is neither demonstrably defended nor demonstrably breached here.
expected: R-EVIDENCE: a symlink-redirected restore write writes within the replacement root or refuses; evidence outside the root is untouched.
observed: UNPROVEN — symlink fixtures cannot be created on this Windows host (no SeCreateSymbolicLink privilege); the interior-subdir-redirect case is unverified and carries residual risk on a symlink-capable host.
